title: Chameleons
synopsis: In Chinese culture, two-faced "chameleons" are disliked for "saying one thing to people and another thing to ghosts".

fullText.simplified:
变色龙

    我们的生活总是不停地变化，所以，适应变化是一种很重要的能力。如果不能适应变化，会给自己的生活带来很多问题。但是，每一次都能适应变化，也不一定是好事。
    变色龙，是一种爬行动物，这种动物能根据环境改变自己的颜色。在汉语里，人们还用这种动物来说一种人。这种人没有自己的想法，总是看别人的眼色做事。中国人很不喜欢这种人，因为这种人做事的时候，总是会看上级的眼色。他觉得这样能让上级满意，自己也能得到好处。这种人一般不会在乎下级的想法，因为他觉得自己的好处最重要。
    生活中，人们常常这样说这种人：“他就是一个变色龙，见人说人话，见鬼说鬼话，可别相信他说的话！”
    在你的身边，有这样的变色龙吗？
fullText.traditional:
變色龍

    我們的生活總是不停地變化，所以，適應變化是一種很重要的能力。如果不能適應變化，會給自己的生活帶來很多問題。但是，每一次都能適應變化，也不一定是好事。
    變色龍，是一種爬行動物，這種動物能根據環境改變自己的顏色。在漢語裡，人們還用這種動物來說一種人。這種人沒有自己的想法，總是看別人的眼色做事。中國人很不喜歡這種人，因為這種人做事的時候，總是會看上級的眼色。他覺得這樣能讓上級滿意，自己也能得到好處。這種人一般不會在乎下級的想法，因為他覺得自己的好處最重要。
    生活中，人們常常這樣說這種人：“他就是一個變色龍，見人說人話，見鬼說鬼話，可別相信他說的話！”
    在你的身邊，有這樣的變色龍嗎？

sentences.simplified: 我们的生活总是不停地变化，所以，适应变化是一种很重要的能力。
sentences.traditional: 我們的生活總是不停地變化，所以，適應變化是一種很重要的能力。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ men de shēng huó zǒng shì bù tíng de biàn huà suǒ yǐ shì yìng biàn huà shì yì zhǒng hěn zhòng yào de néng lì
sentences.english: Our lives are constantly changing, so being able to adapt to change is a very important skill.

sentences.simplified: 如果不能适应变化，会给自己的生活带来很多问题。
sentences.traditional: 如果不能適應變化，會給自己的生活帶來很多問題。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ bù néng shì yìng biàn huà huì gěi zì jǐ de shēng huó dài lái hěn duō wèn tí
sentences.english: If you cannot adapt to change, it can cause many problems in your life.

sentences.simplified: 但是，每一次都能适应变化，也不一定是好事。
sentences.traditional: 但是，每一次都能適應變化，也不一定是好事。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì měi yí cì dōu néng shì yìng biàn huà yě bù yí dìng shì hǎo shì
sentences.english: However, being able to adapt to every change is not necessarily a good thing.

sentences.simplified: 变色龙，是一种爬行动物，这种动物能根据环境改变自己的颜色。
sentences.traditional: 變色龍，是一種爬行動物，這種動物能根據環境改變自己的顏色。
sentences.pinyin: biàn sè lóng shì yì zhǒng pá xíng dòng wù zhè zhǒng dòng wù néng gēn jù huán jìng gǎi biàn zì jǐ de yán sè
sentences.english: The chameleon is a kind of reptile that can change its color according to its surroundings.

sentences.simplified: 在汉语里，人们还用这种动物来说一种人。
sentences.traditional: 在漢語裡，人們還用這種動物來說一種人。
sentences.pinyin: zài hàn yǔ lǐ rén men hái yòng zhè zhǒng dòng wù lái shuō yì zhǒng rén
sentences.english: In Chinese, people also use this animal to describe a certain type of person.

sentences.simplified: 这种人没有自己的想法，总是看别人的眼色做事。
sentences.traditional: 這種人沒有自己的想法，總是看別人的眼色做事。
sentences.pinyin: zhè zhǒng rén méi yǒu zì jǐ de xiǎng fǎ zǒng shì kàn bié rén de yǎn sè zuò shì
sentences.english: This kind of person does not have their own ideas and always acts according to others’ expressions.

sentences.simplified: 中国人很不喜欢这种人，因为这种人做事的时候，总是会看上级的眼色。
sentences.traditional: 中國人很不喜歡這種人，因為這種人做事的時候，總是會看上級的眼色。
sentences.pinyin: zhōng guó rén hěn bù xǐ huan zhè zhǒng rén yīn wèi zhè zhǒng rén zuò shì de shí hou zǒng shì huì kàn shàng jí de yǎn sè
sentences.english: Chinese people really dislike this kind of person because when they do things, they always look at the expressions of their superiors.

sentences.simplified: 他觉得这样能让上级满意，自己也能得到好处。
sentences.traditional: 他覺得這樣能讓上級滿意，自己也能得到好處。
sentences.pinyin: tā jué de zhè yàng néng ràng shàng jí mǎn yì zì jǐ yě néng dé dào hǎo chù
sentences.english: They think that by doing so, they can please their superiors and gain some benefits for themselves.

sentences.simplified: 这种人一般不会在乎下级的想法，
sentences.traditional: 這種人一般不會在乎下級的想法，
sentences.pinyin: zhè zhǒng rén yì bān bú huì zài hu xià jí de xiǎng fǎ
sentences.english: This kind of person usually doesn’t care about the thoughts of their subordinates, ..

sentences.simplified: 因为他觉得自己的好处最重要。
sentences.traditional: 因為他覺得自己的好處最重要。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi tā jué de zì jǐ de hǎo chù zuì zhòng yào
sentences.english: .. because they believe their own benefit is the most important.

sentences.simplified: 生活中，人们常常这样说这种人：
sentences.traditional: 生活中，人們常常這樣說這種人：
sentences.pinyin: shēng huó zhōng rén men cháng cháng zhè yàng shuō zhè zhǒng rén
sentences.english: In everyday life, people often describe this kind of person by saying, ..

sentences.simplified: “他就是一个变色龙，见人说人话，见鬼说鬼话，可别相信他说的话！”
sentences.traditional: “他就是一個變色龍，見人說人話，見鬼說鬼話，可別相信他說的話！”
sentences.pinyin: tā jiù shì yí ge biàn sè lóng jiàn rén shuō rén huà jiàn guǐ shuō guǐ huà kě bié xiāng xìn tā shuō de huà
sentences.english: .. “That person is a chameleon—talks one way to people and another way to ghosts, so don’t trust a word they say!”

sentences.simplified: 在你的身边，有这样的变色龙吗？
sentences.traditional: 在你的身邊，有這樣的變色龍嗎？
sentences.pinyin: zài nǐ de shēn biān yǒu zhè yàng de biàn sè lóng ma
sentences.english: Are there any chameleons like that around you?

sentence_translations: Our lives are constantly changing, so being able to adapt to change is a very important skill.
If you cannot adapt to change, it can cause many problems in your life.
However, being able to adapt to every change is not necessarily a good thing.
The chameleon is a kind of reptile that can change its color according to its surroundings.
In Chinese, people also use this animal to describe a certain type of person.
This kind of person does not have their own ideas and always acts according to others’ expressions.
Chinese people really dislike this kind of person because when they do things, they always look at the expressions of their superiors.
They think that by doing so, they can please their superiors and gain some benefits for themselves.
This kind of person usually doesn’t care about the thoughts of their subordinates, ..
.. because they believe their own benefit is the most important.
In everyday life, people often describe this kind of person by saying, ..
.. “That person is a chameleon—talks one way to people and another way to ghosts, so don’t trust a word they say!”
Are there any chameleons like that around you?
